verdict.rationale: Airweave's search docs mention an AI agent that 'navigates entity hierarchies (parent/child/sibling)' during iterative search, which is a thin nod toward entity-centric relationships, but there is no evidence of an actual knowledge-graph data model, explicit relationship types, or multi-hop graph traversal/querying capability — the product is primarily described as vector/RAG search over synced documents. Missing for 10: explicit knowledge-graph storage of entities/relationships, multi-hop graph query support, and any documentation or demo showing entity-relationship reasoning beyond simple parent/child navigation.
